Veterans Benefits: Alaska has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed, and the state pays an annual Permanent Fund Dividend to residents. Disabled veterans with a 50% or greater service-connected rating receive a property-tax exemption on the first $150,000 of assessed value.

Description: Fairbanks is interior Alaska's hub, base-adjacent to Fort Wainwright (Army) and Eielson AFB, and home to the University of Alaska Fairbanks. It offers no state sales or income tax plus the Permanent Fund Dividend, an in-city VA outpatient clinic, and a rare small-city Costco. The tradeoffs are stark: a subarctic climate with January lows around -17F and about 65 inches of snow, an elevated crime rate, and roughly 260 air miles to the nearest VA hospital in Anchorage.
